# Senior Frontend Engineer

Join our team building a React + TypeScript product used by thousands of analysts. You will ship features across the stack, improve performance of large data tables and charts, and mentor engineers. Requirements: 4-7 years of professional experience, deep React knowledge, TypeScript, testing culture. Nice to have: Node.js, GraphQL, ClickHouse. Location: Hybrid, Bangalore. We offer competitive pay, ESOPs, and flexible hours.
